name: Kimi K2
one_liner: A state-of-the-art mixture-of-experts (MoE) large language model series with 1 trillion total parameters, optimized for agentic capabilities.
tags: Large Language Model, Mixture-of-Experts, Open Source, AI, Agentic Intelligence, Coding, Reasoning
cost_analysis: The model is open source, so there is no direct licensing cost. However, significant computational resources are required for deployment and inference due to its scale (1T total parameters, 32B activated). Costs would be associated with the hardware (e.g., GPUs/TPUs) and cloud compute needed to run the model.
deployment: Available via Hugging Face. Deployment requires significant computational resources to handle the 1T parameter MoE architecture with a 128K context length. Can be fine-tuned from the base model (Kimi-K2-Base) or used directly via the instruction-tuned variant (Kimi-K2-Instruct).
